panels.rationale: Whole-figure plate of 4 panels (A, B, C, D). A: Panel-specific caption describes rapidly progressing erythematous papules and nodules of ATLL patient at first visit and 2 weeks later, visible as multiple red papules/nodules on axilla. B: Skin biopsy from same ATLL patient with H&E plus CD3/CD4/CD8/CD20/CD30/CD56/CD123/EBV-ISH showing dense atypical T-cell infiltration with CD4 predominance, supporting ATLL cutaneous involvement. C: Neck lymph node excisional biopsy from same ATLL patient showing CD4/CD25-positive mature T-cell lymphoma involvement with H&E and CD3/CD25 IHC positivity. D: Chest/abdomen/pelvis CT from same ATLL patient showing abnormal enlarged lymph nodes in neck, abdomen and pelvis with arrows, described as highly suspicious of lymphoma involvement.
